svg.aria-label: The edges of the Codegraph metamodel
svg.desc: An edge connects two entities and is stored once, outgoing. Its 11 kinds, in 4 families by what they connect, each with its ends and the attributes it adds; its 4 provenance values, a dashed one an inference.

a.aria-label: Entity: the rules on an edge's ends
a.text: from ≠ to, each known or a stub
file and span: where it is written

a.aria-label: import: the first-class layer, comparable across languages

text.font-family: Helvetica-Bold, Helvetica, Arial, "Liberation Sans", "Nimbus Sans", sans-serif
